tableLines.text: ◈ THE GRANT — full integration. The System opens the last slot like a door it built just for Vasilisa. "You have been adequate entertainment. We upgrade adequate." (Ability slots: 6)
◈ FULL INTEGRATION — you don't look AT the System anymore. You look WITH it.
◈ The Records: the Bearer won a contest under the cameras. The village's glory, public and loud.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Kathleen speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST

◈ SYSTEM: "FIRST CONTACT, people! Do you KNOW what this is? This is the PILOT for a whole new SHOW. Two fires! One story! The cameras are already fighting over angles — smile, little fires, you're SOM
◈ CRISIS — THE HUNGER WINTER. Three days now the village has gone to sleep hungry. The pantry is an echo. This is the part the old stories skip — the part where you find out what you’re made of.
◈ HAVEN — You've noticed: people cover for each other without being asked. The gaps close themselves.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrot
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Zoe.
📓 Codex: Thornfield split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Sofia — Field 1. Three offers; they took Bird Whisperer. Earned, chosen. (bird_whisperer: villager level-up)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Thornfield bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.

◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesso
🧳 A traveler says Thornfield burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
◈ CRISIS — THE FIRST GRAVE. Kathleen is dead. The village digs its first grave, and everyone understands at once: this place can kill you. It just did.

◈ LEVEL UP — STRANGE 1. "We've been counting: 18 brushes with the System. Pick one."
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Darius.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the south ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 4 people, 30 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
Fresh-cut stems on the south ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Stonebridge's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,50
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the south ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
